constraints.name: Vision-Only Tasks on Text-Only Models
constraints.description: Multimodal visual reasoning (B05) cannot be executed by text-only LLMs (Groq C2, Mistral C3, Cohere C4). Only multimodal endpoints (Gemini C1, OpenRouter C5) support image attachments.
constraints.rationale: Attempting to feed image blocks to text-only model APIs produces a hard 400 Bad Request or unhandled serialization crash rather than valid testable behavior.

constraints.name: Linux Signals on Windows cmd.exe Without ConPTY
constraints.description: POSIX signals (SIGINT/SIGTERM, mid-stream cancellation F4, abrupt kill F5) cannot be cleanly captured or tested in legacy Windows cmd.exe (E2) without ConPTY pseudo-console emulation.
constraints.rationale: Legacy Windows cmd.exe lacks POSIX signal trap propagation; issuing Ctrl+C or kill signals without ConPTY forcibly terminates the parent console process rather than allowing graceful signal handling.

constraints.name: Mid-Stream Interruption on Non-Streaming / Headless JSON
constraints.description: Mid-stream cancellation (F4) cannot be performed against non-streaming headless json commands (B14) because output is returned atomically at process completion without an SSE stream.
constraints.rationale: In headless atomic json mode (--output-format json), tokens are accumulated internally and emitted in a single write at exit. There is no progressive token stream to cancel mid-flight.

constraints.name: Key Revocation Tests on Single-Key Local Configs
constraints.description: Key revocation and 401 pool rollover tests (F2) require a redundant multi-key pool or failover routing (D1/D2). They are invalid against single-key isolated configurations (D5) where no secondary key exists.
constraints.rationale: Testing automatic key pool rotation against a profile configured with exactly one non-pooled key is logically invalid; it tests profile isolation rather than pool rollover.

constraints.name: High-Concurrency Tests on Rate-Limited Free Tiers Without Fallback
constraints.description: High-concurrency load testing (D4) cannot be tested against rate-limited free-tier providers (Groq C2) without failover routing (D1).
constraints.rationale: Free-tier API quotas enforce aggressive per-minute rate limits. Concurrency bursts against an isolated free tier result in deterministic 429 drops rather than valid concurrency throughput testing.
